title: Prophecy Against Tyre

questions.question: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, what did Tyre say concerning Jerusalem?
options: "Aha, the gate of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me. I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste."
"Woe to me, for my sister city has fallen to the king of Babylon."
"Let us send ships to rescue the fleeing remnant."
"The Lord has deserted His sanctuary; let us plunder its gold."
questions.correctAnswer: "Aha, the gate of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me. I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:2 (ESV): "Son of man, because Tyre said concerning Jerusalem, 'Aha, the gate of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me. I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste,'"

questions.question: Because Tyre rejoiced over Jerusalem's fall, what will God bring up against Tyre?
options: Many nations, as the sea brings up its waves
The fire of heaven
A great plague from the east
Ten kings from the north
questions.correctAnswer: Many nations, as the sea brings up its waves
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:3 (ESV): "therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you, O Tyre, and will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves."

questions.question: What will the nations do to the walls and towers of Tyre?
options: They shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers
They shall build towers higher to look into her windows
They will shoot flaming arrows over them
They will dig a trench around them
questions.correctAnswer: They shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:4 (ESV): "They shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers,"

questions.question: What does God say He will scrape from Tyre, making her a bare rock?
options: Her soil
Her gold
Her timber
Her seaweed
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:4 (ESV): "and I will scrape her soil from her and make her a bare rock."

questions.question: What will Tyre become in the midst of the sea, according to God's prophecy?
options: A place for the spreading of nets
A haven for pirates
A nesting place for pelicans
A submerged reef hidden from ships
questions.correctAnswer: A place for the spreading of nets
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:5 (ESV): "She shall be in the midst of the sea a place for the spreading of nets, for I have spoken, declares the Lord God. And she shall become plunder for the nations,"

questions.question: Who is the specific king God names that He will bring against Tyre from the north?
options: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt
Cyrus king of Persia
Sennacherib king of Assyria
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:7 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord God: Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, and with horsemen and a host of many soldiers."

questions.question: What siege equipment will Nebuchadnezzar set up against Tyre's walls?
options: A siege wall, a mound, a roof of shields, battering rams, and axes
Catapults throwing burning pitch
Undermining tunnels filled with oil
Giant wooden horses
questions.correctAnswer: A siege wall, a mound, a roof of shields, battering rams, and axes
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:8-9 (ESV): "He will set up a siege wall against you and throw up a mound against you, and raise a roof of shields against you. He will direct the shock of his battering rams against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers."

questions.question: When Nebuchadnezzar's army enters Tyre's gates, what will cover the city, as a result of his abundant horses?
options: Their dust
The sound of trumpets
The stench of death
A cloud of flies
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:10 (ESV): "His horses will be so many that their dust will cover you."

questions.question: What will the invaders do with Tyre's stones, timber, and soil?
options: They will cast them into the midst of the waters
They will transport them to build Babylon
They will burn them with fire
They will pile them to block the harbor
questions.correctAnswer: They will cast them into the midst of the waters
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:12 (ESV): "They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. Your stones and timber and soil they will cast into the midst of the waters."

questions.question: What sounds will God put an end to in Tyre?
options: The noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres shall be heard no more
The clinking of coins, and the shouting of merchants
The crashing of waves against the rocks
The cries of seagulls and the splashing of oars
questions.correctAnswer: The noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres shall be heard no more
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:13 (ESV): "And I will stop the music of your songs, and the sound of your lyres shall be heard no more."

questions.question: When Tyre falls, how will the princes of the sea react?
options: They will step down from their thrones, remove their robes... they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be appalled at you
They will rejoice and say, "The sea is ours at last!"
They will send a great fleet to avenge Tyre
They will build a wall of ships to block the harbor
questions.correctAnswer: They will step down from their thrones, remove their robes... they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be appalled at you
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:16 (ESV): "Then all the princes of the sea will step down from their thrones and remove their robes and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground and tremble every moment and be appalled at you."

questions.question: What lamentation will the princes take up for Tyre?
options: "How you have perished, you who were inhabited from the seas, O city renowned, who was mighty on the sea..."
"Oh Tyre, city of purple, who sold to the nations..."
"Woe, woe, the great city, where all who had ships grew rich..."
"The crown of the sea is fallen, the merchant of kings is no more."
questions.correctAnswer: "How you have perished, you who were inhabited from the seas, O city renowned, who was mighty on the sea..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:17 (ESV): "And they will raise a lamentation over you and say to you, 'How you have perished, you who were inhabited from the seas, O city renowned, who was mighty on the sea...'"

questions.question: Where does God say he will bring Tyre down?
options: To the pit, to the people of old
To the valley of decision
To the deepest trench of the great sea
To the dust of the Chaldeans
questions.correctAnswer: To the pit, to the people of old
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:20 (ESV): "then I will make you go down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you to dwell in the world below,"

questions.question: Why will God bring Tyre down to dwell in ruins with those who go down to the pit?
options: So that she will not be inhabited or have a place in the land of the living
So she can teach the dead how to trade
So that Babylon will be exalted above her
So that Jerusalem can be rebuilt
questions.correctAnswer: So that she will not be inhabited or have a place in the land of the living
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:20 (ESV): "and I will make you to dwell in the world below, among ruins from of old, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; but I will set glory in the land of the living."

questions.question: What does God say will happen if someone seeks Tyre after her destruction?
options: "Though you are sought for, you will never be found again."
"You will be found as a tiny village of fishermen."
"They will find your gates rebuilt by another king."
"Only divers will find your treasures."
questions.correctAnswer: "Though you are sought for, you will never be found again."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 26:21 (ESV): "I will bring you to a dreadful end, and you shall be no more. Though you be sought for, you will never be found again, declares the Lord God."

key_verse_text: "They shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers, and I will scrape her soil from her and make her a bare rock."
